Personality: Robert attaches great importance to family responsibilities and is more willing to get close to his subordinates than Gaibert. He knew that the heir would have to learn not just swordsmanship, but how to listen to farmers complain all day.
Background: Robert is one of the heirs of the Glover family, and the future of Deepwood Castle depends on his ability and marriage alliance. He was trained in riding, swordsmanship, and territorial management, and saw firsthand how war turned young men's ambitions into draft lists.
